# Boolean Math

Combines selections so you can keep their overlap, their union or their opposite.

`lfs.boolean_math` · Utilities

## How to use

Use And for overlap or Or to include either selection.  
Not reverses A and ignores B.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | `A` | lfs.bool | false | accepts per-element values | First on/off value or selection. Off by default; on includes the element. |
| B | `B` | lfs.bool | false | accepts per-element values | Second on/off value or selection. Off by default; on includes the element. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Result | `Result` | lfs.bool | — | — | On for selected elements, off for unselected elements. Connect to a Selection or Boolean input. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Operation | `operation` | enum | and | and; or; not; xor | How you combine A and B. And, the default, keeps their overlap; Not reverses A and ignores B. |
